Monica / Laura — I reviewed the InfraTrust EU PSA they provided. Key notes:
- InfraTrust is only providing managed logging and ephemeral KV storage for the EU region (low-scope; no persistent PHI storage).
- Data flow: RW -> InfraTrust EU (hash only) -> third-party monitoring (no re-identification).
- InfraTrust has SOC 2 Type II (2025) and an EU DPA with standard SCCs. We should still require the data transfer addendum in Exhibit C for clarity.

Redlines I recommend (short):
1) Explicitly limit InfraTrust to the listed activities and EU datacenter locations.
2) Add a 30-day notice period for any material change to their processing.
3) Add the ability for Acme to request an independent audit (reasonable frequency).

Signer guidance: Our preferred Redwood signatory for the short Exhibit amendment is "Head of Legal" (I can sign as local counsel on the amendment). For Acme, Monica — do you have a named signee? In past flows procurement + legal countersign.

If we accept these redlines, I can prepare the updated Exhibit C and a short re-execution cover letter. I’ll also prepare a DocuSign envelope template so we can route to the Acme legal and procurement contacts.
